objective: Implement standalone GitHub provider port for exact scoped branch publish and verified PR merge

acceptance.text: Injected command runner implements the accepted inspect/publish/merge protocol with exact checkout/head/remote/PR identity, bounded output and precise distinct failure states. No shell or real remote calls occur in tests.

Publish pushes only the expected head without force or tracking configuration changes, creates/updates exactly one PR, preserves draft policy and passes exact bounded bodies through temporary mode0600 body files cleaned on every outcome.

Merge requires exact head plus passing required checks or the documented positively proven no-required-checks+CLEAN result, uses normal server protections and match-head-commit, and requires actual merged commit and remote integration proof. Races, ambiguity, queueing, failures and malformed output never report completion.
